scope: Node CPU real seven-slot shared-source actor pipeline; no WebGL, GPU, FPS, visual or interaction acceptance

method.units: milliseconds; active batches are per group tick means, individual samples are group call latency
method.active: shared body static, eight layers x56 influences; sequential 0.8s cue spacing, all canonical clock events processed
method.prepare: read, copy, hash, preflight, profile validation
method.coldCreate: GLTF parse, source numeric/material/rest parity and first clone
method.cachedClone: only remaining actor clones, zero for actor count1
method.gc: No forced GC; cloud noise applies
method.memory: source bytes, reserved decoded backing, measured actual backing and theoretical renderer texture estimates are separate; no total heap/VRAM claim
